_comment: One spoken quip per story for the week's Reel (scripts/ig-reel.py). Real spellings; the script applies the LEXICON's TTS respellings itself. Keep each under about fifteen words — it is said and shown.
intro: Nineteen things in South Knoxville this Halloween weekend. The costume is not optional.
outro: That's the weekend. The whole briefing is at soknoear.com. Link in bio.

quips.halloween-pub-crawl: Eleven stops, one passport: the Old Sevier Halloween Pub Crawl, all day Saturday, free.
quips.puckers-boos-and-brews: Pumpkin beer pong and a cash costume prize at Puckers, Thursday from five thirty.
quips.wax-museum-fbn: Wax Museum spins spooky vinyl rarities at Fly by Night Thursday night.
quips.freaks-ball-fbn: Freaks Come Out at Night: three DJs at Fly by Night Friday at nine, ten dollars.
quips.808-90s-rave: A free 90s rave with Psychonaut at The 808 Friday. Doors at seven.
quips.808-bear-grillz: Bear Grillz plays The 808 on Halloween night. Doors at seven, eighteen and up.
quips.pink-is-punk-halloweemo: Emo anthems remixed till two at the Pink Cactus Friday, a dating gameshow first.
quips.belltower-hiween: A haunted house party at the Pink Cactus Saturday: free karaoke after nine, till two.
quips.dia-de-los-muertos-pink-cactus: Día de los Muertos at the Pink Cactus Sunday: free cumbia class, catrina face paint.
quips.drop-dead-drag-hiwire: Drop Dead: a Halloween drag show and costume contest at Hi-Wire, Saturday at nine.
quips.trailhead-jake-smith-trio: Jake Smith Trio on the Trailhead patio Friday at seven. Free.
quips.trailhead-four-legged-dog: Four Legged Dog plays Trailhead on Halloween night at seven. Free.
quips.trailhead-mt-olive: Mt Olive Pleasure Club closes the weekend at Trailhead, Sunday at four.
quips.kerns-hodown: Line dancing, a mechanical bull and a Thriller lesson at Kern's Friday night.
quips.starlight-paddle: A guided kayak paddle under the stars at Ijams Nature Center, Friday at seven.
quips.playscape-storytime-bats: Free bat storytime at the Ijams Nature Center playscape, Halloween morning at ten.
quips.playing-possum: Meet the new opossum at Ijams Nature Center, Saturday at eleven. Ten dollars.
quips.renew-in-nature: Yoga, a sound bath and forest bathing at Ijams Nature Center, Sunday at ten.
quips.specials-board: A different rita every day at Earl's through Halloween, then seven-dollar mimosas Sunday.
